title: Glowing ice cream cone
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="glow" cx="50%" cy="50%" r="50%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#FFE066" stop-opacity="0.6"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#FFE066" stop-opacity="0"/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx="50" cy="45" r="42" fill="url(#glow)"/>
  <!-- cone -->
  <polygon points="35,55 65,55 52,92 48,92" fill="#D4A24E"/>
  <polygon points="35,55 50,55 48,92 52,92 65,55" fill="#E8C06A"/>
  <!-- cone crosshatch -->
  <line x1="40" y1="62" x2="58" y2="62" stroke="#C49040" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="70" x2="56" y2="70" stroke="#C49040" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="78" x2="54" y2="78" stroke="#C49040" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="58" x2="48" y2="90" stroke="#C49040" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <line x1="53" y1="58" x2="50" y2="90" stroke="#C49040" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <!-- bottom scoop (chocolate) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="50" r="15" fill="#8B5E3C"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="47" r="6" fill="#A0704A"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="52" r="5" fill="#7A4E2E"/>
  <!-- top scoop (strawberry) -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="33" r="14" fill="#FF7EB3"/>
  <circle cx="45" cy="29" r="5" fill="#FFA8CC"/>
  <circle cx="55" cy="36" r="4" fill="#E8609A"/>
  <!-- cherry -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="19" r="6" fill="#FF3B3B"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="17" r="2" fill="#FF8A8A"/>
  <path d="M50,13 Q53,8 57,7" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="2" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- sprinkles -->
  <rect x="40" y="38" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFE066" transform="rotate(30,42,39)"/>
  <rect x="55" y="40" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#66E0FF" transform="rotate(-20,57,41)"/>
  <rect x="46" y="44" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#B366FF" transform="rotate(50,48,45)"/>
  <rect x="57" y="47" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#66FF99" transform="rotate(-40,59,48)"/>
  <rect x="44" y="24" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#FFE066" transform="rotate(-25,46,25)"/>
  <rect x="55" y="27" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#66E0FF" transform="rotate(35,57,28)"/>
</svg>
